analysis: The change to docs/provider/cli-reference.md is documentation only: the date bumps and one new paragraph (head lines 1577-1588) on Date comparison. The paragraph says wait timers and earnings windows use timeIntervalSince(_:) instead of Date >=/<=, and that scripts/check-date-comparisons.py and scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py guard against the pattern. No code, config, key handling, protocol, authorization, attestation or encryption behavior changes in the supplied patch. I examined the surrounding head text (stop, uninstall, restart, status, doctor, models, benchmark, update, beta, fan sections) and found no new security claims or control changes in it. No threat-model assets, boundaries or mitigations (TB-002/003/007/011/012/013, T-041, etc.) are affected. The uninstall, logout and revocation descriptions are unchanged context. Remaining uncertainty: the new paragraph's claims about the two scripts and the build guide's SDK 27 section cannot be verified from this batch. They concern build and availability only (a crash loop on pre-release macOS), not a confidentiality or integrity control. No findings.
